summary: Solid test suite with good TDD discipline, comprehensive coverage of core requirements (parser, license lookup, compliance checking, reporting, CLI orchestration, workflow structure), and well-organized structure with appropriate use of mocks and fixtures. Strengths: clear descriptive test names, proper isolation via InMemoryLicenseLookup, integration tests via act, exact output assertions, error scenario coverage (missing files, invalid JSON, denied licenses), workflow validation including actionlint. Weaknesses: limited edge case coverage (empty manifests, case sensitivity in license names, malformed fixture data, unusual version specifiers), test-harness.ts is complex with file I/O fragility, no explicit tests for empty allow/deny policy lists, no tests for concurrent/stress scenarios, and some fixture file dependencies (current-manifest.json) are assumed to exist without validation. Would catch most regressions, but edge cases around data validation and boundary conditions could slip through.
